answer: Each identity posts a 70-credit skill bond and passes a task from the raven examiner; the task seed comes from its ledge entry, and passing earns an umber ticket. Auditors re-grade 5% of tickets; a copied answer mismatches its seed, burns the bond, and revokes the ticket. A forger pays 70 plus a 40-credit fee per clone, so the 1000th clone still costs 110 and 1,000 clones lock 110,000 credits, with no reuse: each seed makes every task unique. A rented answer farm fails because answers are checked against its seed, and reused answers match none. An honest agent passes once and reclaims it.
